subject: Decision Making
subcategory: Famous Decisions That Changed the World
title: The Signing of the Declaration
description: A 60-second lesson on The Signing of the Declaration.

hook.text: On July 4, 1776, delegates signed a document that made them traitors to the British Crown. The penalty was death.

buildup.text: Many delegates hesitated. Independence meant war against the world's strongest military with no guarantee of victory.

discovery.text: Benjamin Franklin reportedly said, 'We must all hang together, or most assuredly we shall all hang separately.'

twist.text: Five signers were captured and tortured. Twelve had their homes burned. They paid the price they had accepted.

climax.text: The Declaration shows that some decisions require accepting total loss. The signers chose principle over safety.

punchline.text: Sign and risk death, or stay silent and stay safe. They signed.

quiz.question: What risk did the signers of the Declaration accept?
options: Being charged with treason and potentially executed
